name: PhantomOperator
description: Authorized privacy and public-exposure analysis for people and AI agents. Includes metadata audits, breach indicators, OPSEC and wallet-hygiene checks, and removal guidance. Does not submit removal requests on a user’s behalf.

skills.name: Metadata Privacy Audit
skills.description: Fetch any HTTP/HTTPS URL and extract all metadata that could de-anonymise its author or expose infrastructure details: HTTP response headers, HTML <meta> tags, inline HTML comments, and third-party tracker origins.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: Absolute HTTP/HTTPS URL to audit

skills.name: Threat Scan
skills.description: Searches the public web for mentions of a person's name that contain PII (phone numbers, email addresses, SSNs, home address). Returns a threat report with severity levels.

inputs.name: fullName
inputs.description: Full name of the person to scan for

skills.name: Breach & Credential Exposure Check
skills.description: Checks an email address against public breach intelligence (XposedOrNot + HIBP) and optionally checks a password via HIBP k-anonymity SHA-1 range query (only first 5 hex chars transmitted).

inputs.name: email
inputs.description: Email address to check for breach exposure

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: Optional plaintext password to check via k-anonymity

skills.name: OPSEC Exposure Score
skills.description: Multi-vector operational security exposure assessment. Aggregates public web search, data broker indexing, paste/leak sites, and social media footprint into a scored report (0–100) with grade A–F and prioritised remediation steps.

inputs.name: fullName
inputs.description: Full legal name of the target (optional if handle or email provided)

inputs.name: handle
inputs.description: Online pseudonym / username to assess (optional)

inputs.name: email
inputs.description: Email address to include in the assessment (optional)

skills.name: $XMR Monero Cryptographic & Network OPSEC Audit
skills.description: Decodes a supplied Monero address, checks its format and public privacy-posture signals, and returns structured guidance with a commitment proof.

inputs.name: xmrAddress
inputs.description: Monero Standard (4...), Subaddress (8...), or Integrated address to decode and audit

inputs.name: txHash
inputs.description: Optional 64-character hex Monero transaction hash to inspect

inputs.name: evmAddress
inputs.description: Optional EVM address to evaluate EVM <-> $XMR cross-chain correlation risk

inputs.name: swapAmountXmr
inputs.description: Optional XMR amount to evaluate EAE timing/amount correlation

inputs.name: nodeMode
inputs.description: Optional node connectivity mode: local / remote-tor / remote-clearnet

skills.name: Automated Data Broker Removal & Statutory Takedown
skills.description: Matches a supplied, authorized data-broker listing against supported removal paths and generates a reviewable CCPA/GDPR-style request. It does not submit removal requests without explicit authorization.

inputs.name: link
inputs.description: URL of the data broker listing to remove

inputs.name: fullName
inputs.description: Full name of the person requesting removal (optional)

skills.name: EVM & Cross-Chain Wallet Deanonymization Audit
skills.description: Reviews public Base/EVM wallet hygiene signals, including observable activity and ERC-8004 identity references, and provides privacy recommendations.

inputs.name: walletAddress
inputs.description: 0x EVM wallet address to audit

skills.name: Full Multi-Operator Privacy Sweep
skills.description: Combines authorized threat scanning, exposure scoring, and data-broker removal guidance into a structured privacy report.

inputs.name: fullName
inputs.description: Full name of the person to protect

inputs.name: email
inputs.description: Optional email address to include in the sweep

inputs.name: handle
inputs.description: Optional handle/username to include in the sweep

inputs.name: walletAddress
inputs.description: Optional EVM wallet address

skills.name: Cypherpunk Red-Team & $XMR Sovereign Dossier (Pro Tier)
skills.description: Combines selected, authorized metadata, public-exposure, breach, wallet, and Monero privacy modules into a structured dossier.

inputs.name: fullName
inputs.description: Target name or organization (authorized assessment)

inputs.name: email
inputs.description: Email address for breach & OSINT correlation

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: Target web URL for metadata & header audit

inputs.name: walletAddress
inputs.description: Optional 0x EVM wallet address

inputs.name: xmrAddress
inputs.description: Optional $XMR Monero address/subaddress

skills.name: Sovereign Enterprise OPSEC & Zero-Trace Architecture Package
skills.description: Produces an organization-level, authorized privacy and operational-security assessment package; it is not a managed retainer or financial service.

inputs.name: organization
inputs.description: Organization, DAO, or principal name

inputs.name: email
inputs.description: Primary security/principal email

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: Primary domain HTTP/HTTPS URL

inputs.name: walletAddress
inputs.description: Primary treasury or operational 0x EVM address

inputs.name: xmrAddress
inputs.description: Optional $XMR settlement subaddress

skills.name: Spam Caller-ID Removal Guidance
skills.description: Prepare official caller-ID unlisting and spam-label dispute steps for an authorized phone number. Does not submit requests.

inputs.name: phoneNumber
inputs.description: Authorized phone number in international format

inputs.name: provider
inputs.description: Optional: truecaller, hiya, robokiller, or whitepages

inputs.name: authorized
inputs.description: Must be true to confirm authorization
